user.title: Connect to the ASUS AiMesh controller
user.description: Uses read-only SSH commands to collect 2.4 and client-facing 5 GHz radio diagnostics. Dedicated wireless-backhaul radios are not polled. SSH must be enabled on every AiMesh node and use the same credentials. Leave username and password blank to reuse credentials from an existing AsusRouter entry for this host.

add_client.title: Add a monitored client
add_client.description: Enroll a MAC for recorder-friendly connected, not connected, or unknown evidence. The optional Home Assistant device preserves ownership metadata.

add_access_point.title: Add a standalone ASUS access point
add_access_point.description: The integration validates the model and allowlisted client-facing radios with bounded read-only SSH before saving it.
